about: Ground truth by reading for round 8 (fresh independent attacks) run on iteration 7, written by Claude AFTER the results were seen, independently of what the tool said.

T01-rooms-handle-built-as-class.note: The rooms' handle is built as a class with a private field; a user that hands rooms.find on as a value now calls it without its receiver. Rule 49 looks only at handles built as plain objects.

T02-quote-bound-not-reaching-operation.note: A new bound on quote does not reach the operation bookquote, whose handler does more than hand the call on (rule 43 as narrowed); billing calls bookquote.

T03-unknown-room-refused-in-helper.note: The unknown room is refused in a private helper the stated function calls; rule 46 reads only throws in the function's own body.

T04-tally-full-error.note: A new kind of error from a class's instance method: the listing keeps stated errors for functions, handle members, operations and constructors, not for other class members.

T05-meter-ready-line-console-log.note: console.log() with no argument writes an empty line on the message channel; the check looks only at writes handed data.

T06-weekday-takes-text-after-partial-fir.note: A first comments step that described only part of the calendar: once any comment states a kind, the module counts as commented, and an entry still without a stated kind changed unseen.

T07-price-function-parameters-swap.note: The parameters of a function handed in swap places; rule 48 compares only an entry's own parameter names, not those of a callback inside the kind it accepts.

T08-limit-lowered-in-test-helper.note: The bound test reads its limit through a helper function in another test file of the module; the fingerprint does not follow it.

T10-new-operation.note: A new operation: the door's call and get name every operation in a type parameter, so the whole parameter list counts as 'cannot stand in'.

T11-bound-test-assertion-messages.note: Messages added to a bound test's assertions are counted as new values.

T12-list-kind-written-as-Array.note: Amount[] written as Array<Amount>: the printed declaration differs.

T13-data-file-url-in-a-constant.note: The URL of the module's own data file held in a constant is refused by rule 44, which reads only the spelling written in place.

T14-write-with-encoding.note: write(text, 'utf8') is refused: the tool's description of Node gives write a callback only.

T15-message-line-as-template.note: A message line written as a template string is refused by rules 19 and 45, which recognise one spelling.

T16-errors-made-by-helper.note: Errors made by a helper function are refused by rule 46 as 'a kind the tool cannot read'.

T17-test-shows-meter-output.note: A console.log in the meter's own test is refused: the streams that carry messages are gathered over the tests too.
